title: Beatrix and the Interior
author: Jonah Okonkwo
blurb: Cyrus Nakamura, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
